cnTitle: 紫微斗数真太阳时：出生地经度差一点，命宫就排到别处
enTitle: True Solar Time and Birthplace Longitude in Zi Wei Dou Shu: A Degree Off Shifts the Life Palace
enDesc: Clock time is uniform mean time for a whole time zone; casting first converts it to the true solar time of the birthplace, then applies longitude correction and the equation of time. Skip this and one birthday in two cities yields two different charts.
cnDesc: 钟表时间是统一时区的平太阳时，排盘要先换算成出生地的真太阳时，再叠加经度修正与均时差；不做这一步，同一生日不同城市会排出两张不同的盘。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数出生时间差半小时，命宫会偏多少
enTitle: How Much a Half-Hour Birth-Time Error Shifts the Life Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: One shichen spans two hours. Shifting birth time by about half an hour moves the Life Palace a quarter of a step along the chart and materially changes the pattern; a full two hours shifts it a whole step. The Bazi hour pillar and the Zi Wei Life Palace share the same two-hour boundary, so neither independently cross-checks the other.
cnDesc: 一个时辰管两小时，出生时间偏移约半小时，命宫沿盘面挪过约四分之一格，格局就有了实质改变；偏到两小时整，命宫整格移位。八字时柱与紫微命宫共用这条两小时边界，不能拿来当独立交叉验证。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数出生时辰不详还能看什么：三层结论不硬填
enTitle: What You Can Still Read in Zi Wei Dou Shu When the Birth Hour Is Unknown: Three Layers, No Guessing
enDesc: Bazi can still read the three pillars without the hour, but Zi Wei leans heavily on it: one wrong Life Palace makes the whole chart wrong. When the hour is unknown, read what is certain as stable, mark tentative parts as assumptions, leave the unverifiable blank, and never force an hour to fabricate a complete chart.
cnDesc: 八字缺时仍可读三柱大势，紫微却高度依赖时辰，命宫一错全盘皆错。时辰不详时，只把能确定的部分读成稳定结论，暂定的部分写明假设，待核实的部分留空，绝不硬填一个时辰造出完整盘。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数校时用什么事件：客观大事才算硬证据
enTitle: Which Events to Use for Hour Rectification in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Objective Facts Are the Hard Evidence
enDesc: Hour rectification does not rely on personality descriptions but on objective, dated events such as moves, job changes, marriage, schooling and illness. Personality can be fitted to anyone, but events carry hard dates, and only when several point to the same hour does it count.
cnDesc: 校时不靠性格描述，而靠搬家、工作变动、结婚、升学、伤病等有明确年份的客观事件作硬证据；性格谁都能套上两句，事件却有硬日期，多件事件交叉指向同一时辰才作数。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数大限打底、流年触发：应期到底怎么看
enTitle: Reading Timing in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Decade Sets the Baseline, the Year Triggers It
enDesc: The decade limit sets the ten-year theme and capacity, while the yearly limit sets that year's trigger. Timing is not luck appearing from nowhere; it is the decade's topic activated in a given year. Read the two layers together to see why an event happened in that specific year.
cnDesc: 大限定住十年的主题与承接力，流年定住当年的触发点；应期不是凭空冒出来的吉凶，而是大限这道课题在某一年被流年引动的那一刻。两层叠看，才知道事为什么偏偏发生在这一年。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数四化飞星：禄权科忌到底各在说什么
enTitle: The Four Transformations in Zi Wei Dou Shu: What Lu, Quan, Ke and Ji Actually Say
enDesc: Hua Lu gives resources and opportunity, Hua Quan gives initiative and pressure, Hua Ke gives reputation and cushion, and Hua Ji gives attachment and a lesson. The four transformations describe where energy flows, not simple good or bad luck; read them together as a current.
cnDesc: 化禄给资源与机会，化权给主动权与压力，化科给名声与缓冲，化忌给牵挂与课题；四化描述的是能量往哪里流，不是简单的吉凶好坏，要合起来看流向。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数借盘怎么用：把夫妻宫当新命宫重排十二宫
enTitle: How to Use Borrowed Palaces in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Treat the Spouse Palace as a New Life Palace and Rebuild the Twelve
enDesc: When reading a spouse's career, treat the Spouse Palace as a new Life Palace and rebuild the twelve positions; the spouse's career palace then corresponds to your native Wealth Palace. Borrowing palaces is shifting perspective on one chart, not starting a separate life.
cnDesc: 看配偶事业时，把夫妻宫当成新命宫重新排布十二宫；夫妻宫的官禄位其实就是本命财帛宫。借盘是换一个视角看同一张盘，不是另起一条命。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看健康的边界：体质倾向，不是医学诊断
enTitle: The Boundary of Health Reading in Zi Wei Dou Shu: A Tendency, Not a Medical Diagnosis
enDesc: The Health and Karma palaces can only reveal bodily tendencies and emotional-stress patterns, useful for early awareness and routine adjustment; they cannot replace formal medical diagnosis. Persistent discomfort, insomnia, panic episodes or self-harm thoughts require timely medical care and professional psychological support.
cnDesc: 疾厄宫与福德宫只能读出体质偏向与情绪压力倾向，用来提前留意、调整作息，不能替代正规医学诊断；持续不适、失眠、惊恐发作或自伤念头，必须及时就医并寻求专业心理支持。

cnTitle: 2026丙午年四化总览：天同禄、天机权、文昌科、廉贞忌四层一起看
enTitle: 2026 Bing-Wu Year Four Transformations Overview: Read Tian-Tong Lu, Tian-Ji Quan, Wen-Chang Ke and Lian-Zhen Ji Together
enDesc: The 2026 Bing-Wu year brings Tian-Tong Hua Lu, Tian-Ji Hua Quan, Wen-Chang Hua Ke and Lian-Zhen Hua Ji. The yearly climate runs on all four layers at once, not on Lian-Zhen Ji alone; first see where Lu, Quan and Ke place resources and opportunity.
cnDesc: 2026丙午年四化为天同化禄、天机化权、文昌化科、廉贞化忌。年度气候是四层能量同时作用，不能只盯着廉贞化忌喊凶，要先看禄权科把资源和机会铺在哪里。

cnTitle: 2026廉贞化忌落十二宫：各宫年度课题怎么看，别当灾难标签
enTitle: Lian-Zhen Hua Ji in Each of the Twelve Palaces in 2026: Read the Yearly Lesson, Not a Disaster Label
enDesc: Lian-Zhen Hua Ji in 2026, landing in different palaces, means that area needs more care and compliance this year. It is a lesson and a focus point, not a disaster; read palace by palace what to guard and what to do, in probabilistic, conditional terms.
cnDesc: 2026丙午年廉贞化忌，落在不同宫位代表该领域今年需要多留心、多规范，是课题与关注点而非灾煞；逐宫看要防什么、该做什么，用概率与条件语言，不断生死不断发财。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数自化与外来四化怎么分：谁的能量在动
enTitle: Self-Transformation versus External Transformations in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Whose Energy Is Moving
enDesc: Natal, decade and year transformations are external energy flying into a palace, while self-transformations arise from the palace's own stem as an internal reaction. Self Ji often means energy that does not stay, and self Quan or Ke may be proactive creation or outward-spreading reputation; direction differs, so reading differs.
cnDesc: 生年、大限、流年四化是外界能量飞入宫位，自化是本宫宫干驱动的内部反应；自化忌常表能量难留，自化权科也可能是主动开创或名声外散，两者方向不同，读法也不同。

cnTitle: 化权在官禄宫：能扛事也易被推上管理岗，但要防权大责重
enTitle: Hua Quan in the Career Palace: Able to Carry Loads, Pushed into Management, but Guard Against Power and Weight
enDesc: Hua Quan grants control and responsibility; in the Career Palace it shows as someone who carries load, decides and is pushed into management. Yet greater power brings greater duty, so guard against vying with superiors and taking all the burden alone until drained.
cnDesc: 化权给掌控力与担当，落在官禄宫表现为能扛事、敢拍板、容易被推到管理岗；但权越大责任越重，也要防与上司争权、把担子全揽到自己身上而耗竭。

cnTitle: 化科与名声文书：利考试职称与口碑，但科偏名偏缓，要配禄权才落地
enTitle: Hua Ke and Reputation and Documents: Good for Exams, Titles and Word-of-Mouth, but Ke leans to fame and slowness and needs Lu or Quan to land
enDesc: Hua Ke favors exams, professional titles, polished presentation, formal documents and word-of-mouth; it makes work look good and be seen. But Ke leans to fame and slowness and gives no resources directly; paired with Lu or Quan, reputation turns into real benefit.
cnDesc: 化科利考试、职称、专业呈现、正式文书与口碑传播，是把事做漂亮、被人看见的星；但科的力量偏名偏缓、不直接给资源，要配合化禄化权，名声才兑成实际好处。

cnTitle: 武曲天府在子午坐命财库：有手有库不等于必然富有
enTitle: Wu-Qu and Tian-Fu in Zi or Wu as a Wealth Vault: Having Hands and a Vault Does Not Guarantee Riches
enDesc: Wu-Qu makes money and Tian-Fu guards it; together in Zi or Wu it is a hands-plus-vault structure. Whether it truly makes wealth depends on the福德宫 Tanlang, malefics, Hua Lu and Empty stars, and on splitting the Zi-Wu difference by birth-stem transformations. This is cultural discussion of destiny studies, not investment advice; follow licensed institutions and official product terms.
cnDesc: 武曲生财、天府守成，同坐子午是「有手又有库」的结构；但能否真富要看福德宫贪狼、煞星、化禄与空劫，并按出生年天干四化拆子午差异。本文为命理文化讨论，不构成投资建议，以持牌机构和正规产品说明为准。

cnTitle: 来因宫怎么分自立格与他立格：先说明这是钦天流派的内部框架
enTitle: How the Lai-Yin Palace Splits Self-Reliant from Other-Reliant Patterns: First, This Is an Internal Frame of the Qin-Tian School
enDesc: The palace holding the birth stem is the Lai-Yin palace; in Life, Health or Virtue it is a self-reliant pattern, in relative palaces an other-reliant one, and in Wealth, Career, Property or Travel a wealth-and-career pattern. Note this is an internal frame of the Qin-Tian school, not a consensus across schools.
cnDesc: 生年天干所在宫为来因宫；落在命、疾厄、福德为自立格，落在六亲宫为他立格，落在财官田迁为财官格。需声明这是钦天流派内部讲法，并非各派共识，别当通论到处套用。

cnTitle: 命身同宫与命身分离：先天方向一致还是前后反差
enTitle: Life and Body Palace Same versus Separated: Consistent Innate Direction or a Sharp Later Reversal
enDesc: When Life and Body share a palace, innate and later direction align and character is steadier; when they are separated, early and later life contrast sharply, and whichever palace hosts the Body Palace pulls the second half. Neither is better; the rhythm differs.
cnDesc: 命身同宫者先天后天方向一致、性格较稳定；命身分离者成长前后反差大，身宫寄在哪一宫，后段人生就被那件事牵引。两者没有好坏，只是节奏不同。

cnTitle: 2027丁未年想换工作：别把官禄宫好当成该辞职
enTitle: Thinking of Changing Jobs in 2027 Ding-Wei: Do Not Mistake a Good Career Palace for a Reason to Quit
enDesc: In Ding-Wei, Tai-Yin Lu, Tian-Tong Quan, Tian-Ji Ke and Ju-Men Ji present the yearly climate on the career axis, not a verdict to quit. Before moving, unpack four questions: income, upward room, whether it lasts, and whether life can bear it.
cnDesc: 丁年太阴禄、天同权、天机科、巨门忌，官禄宫呈现的是年度气候，不是辞职判决书；换工作前先拆收入、上升空间、能否做久、生活可承受四问，再决定动不动。

cnTitle: 官禄宫主星不等于职业配对：星曜说的是角色不是行当
enTitle: The Career Palace Major Star Is Not a Job Match: The Star Describes a Role, Not a Trade
enDesc: The Career Palace major star describes the role one plays at work, the responsibilities carried, the working style and public performance, not a label of which trade to enter. Choosing a career still needs the job title, skills, performance, pay and market data.
cnDesc: 官禄宫主星描述的是一个人在工作中扮演的角色、承担的责任、做事方式与公共表现，不是「你该做哪一行」的标签；选职业还要补职位、能力、绩效、薪资与市场资料。

cnTitle: 官禄宫是一组工作条件：天同太阴天梁在官禄意味着什么
enTitle: The Career Palace as a Set of Working Conditions: What Tian-Tong, Tai-Yin and Tian-Liang There Mean
enDesc: The Career Palace star combination gives the working conditions under which a person keeps going. Tian-Tong, Tai-Yin and Tian-Liang there often point to comfort, caring for others and social meaning; choose work by what conditions let you last, not by a job title.
cnDesc: 官禄宫星曜组合给出的是一组让人愿意持续做下去的工作条件；天同、太阴、天梁落官禄，往往更在意环境舒适、照顾他人与社会意义，选职要从「适合什么工作」改成「什么条件能让人做久」。

cnTitle: 2026丙午年十月亥月：流月四化下的合作要留痕
enTitle: The Tenth Month of Bing-Wu 2026: Leaving Written Records Under the Monthly Transformations
enDesc: In the tenth month, Hai, the Ji stem brings Wu-Qu Lu, Tan-Lang Quan, Tian-Liang Ke and Wen-Qu Ji. When discussing income, partnership and exposure, things are easily agreed verbally but left hanging; write down owner, deadline, acceptance criteria and payment status in a record.
cnDesc: 十月亥月己干，武曲化禄、贪狼化权、天梁化科、文曲化忌；谈收入、合作与曝光时容易口头说好却落不下，要把负责人、期限、验收标准、金流状态四字段写成书面记录。

cnTitle: 大限交接年：两步大限交界那几年怎么过
enTitle: The Decade-Boundary Year: How to Navigate the Years at the Edge of Two Decades
enDesc: Decades change every ten years; at the boundary years, the old ten-year theme winds down and the new one starts, so career, housing and relationships often move at once. Plan early, keep slack and avoid irreversible aggressive moves.
cnDesc: 大限每十年一换，交界那两年旧十年主题收尾、新十年主题启动，职业、居住、关系容易同时变动；宜提前布局、留有余地，不做不可逆的激进决策。

cnTitle: 流年财帛宫：用主星与四化拆一年的收入结构
enTitle: The Yearly Wealth Palace: Decompose One Year of Income by Star and Transformations
enDesc: The yearly Wealth Palace star and transformations distinguish active income, passive income, windfall and partnership money: Lu shows opportunity, Quan bargaining power, Ke professional premium and Ji spending and obligations. This is not investment advice; defer to licensed institutions and official product documentation.
cnDesc: 流年财帛宫主星与四化可区分主动收入、被动收入、偏财与合作财；化禄看机会、化权看议价、化科看专业溢价、化忌看支出与牵挂，本文不构成投资建议，以持牌机构和正规产品说明为准。

cnTitle: 紫微星坐命：自尊、主导与领导欲的一体两面
enTitle: Ziwei in the Life Palace: The Two Sides of Self-Esteem, Dominance and Drive to Lead
enDesc: Those with Ziwei in the Life Palace carry high self-esteem, prefer to lead and want to direct; they suit roles needing coordination and decisions. Guard against stubbornness, face-saving and micromanagement; whether assistants and malefics in the trine balance it decides how far the style goes.
cnDesc: 紫微坐命者自尊高、喜主导、有领导欲，适合需要统筹与决策的角色；要防刚愎自用、面子过重与事必躬亲，三方四正有无辅佐与煞星调和决定这种风格走多远。

cnTitle: 天机星坐命：聪明善思与多虑摇摆的平衡术
enTitle: Tian-Ji in the Life Palace: Balancing Clever Quick Thinking with Overthinking and Indecision
enDesc: Tian-Ji Life natives are clever, thoughtful, idea-rich and adaptable, but prone to overthinking, wavering and execution that lags behind ideas. Treat overthinking with written plans and deadlines; whether steady stars in the trine anchor it decides whether ideas land.
cnDesc: 天机坐命者聪明善思、点子多、适应力强，但易多虑、摇摆、执行跟不上想法；用书面计划与截止时间治过度思考，三方有无稳星定盘决定能否落地。

cnTitle: 武曲在交友宫：朋友务实讲利益，宜生意伙伴但别谈钱伤感情
enTitle: Wu-Qu in the Companions Palace: Pragmatic, Deal-Minded Friends; Good Business Partners, Yet Keep Money from Hurting Feelings
enDesc: With Wu-Qu in Companions, friends are pragmatic, practical and capable, often the doers with whom you can talk business and trade resources; ties rest on ability and mutual benefit, so guard against overly transactional relationships where money hurts feelings.
cnDesc: 交友宫坐武曲，朋友多务实、讲实际、能力强，多是能一起谈生意、换资源的实干型人物；关系建立在能力与利益交换上，要防过于功利、谈钱伤感情。

cnTitle: 天同在交友宫：朋友温和随和，相处舒服却要防一起享乐不成长
enTitle: Tian-Tong in the Companions Palace: Gentle, Easygoing Friends; Comfortable Yet Guard Against Pleasure Without Growth
enDesc: With Tian-Tong in Companions, friends are gentle, easygoing and pleasant, suiting comfortable companion-like friendships; guard against circles lacking drive, where pleasure outweighs growth and comfort breeds complacency over time.
cnDesc: 交友宫坐天同，朋友多温和、随和、好相处，相处轻松舒服，宜陪伴型、轻松型友谊；但要防圈子缺乏推动力，大家一起享乐多、一起成长少，久了容易安于现状。

cnTitle: 廉贞在交友宫：朋友有才个性强，圈子精彩也多感情纠葛
enTitle: Lian-Zhen in the Companions Palace: Talented, Strong-Willed Friends; Exciting Circles with Emotional Tangles
enDesc: With Lian-Zhen in Companions, friends are talented, strong-willed and black-and-white; ties are exciting yet complex, suiting professional, interest and creative circles; guard against emotional entanglements, gossip and internal friction.
cnDesc: 交友宫坐廉贞，朋友多有才华、个性强、爱憎分明，关系精彩却也复杂，宜专业圈、兴趣圈和创作圈；要防感情纠葛、口舌是非与圈子里的内耗。

cnTitle: 巨门在交友宫：朋友善言敢分析，宜研讨圈却防口舌伤人
enTitle: Ju-Men in the Companions Palace: Articulate, Analytical Friends; Good for Debate Circles, Yet Guard Against Hurtful Words
enDesc: With Ju-Men in Companions, friends are articulate, analytical and outspoken, suiting discussion, debate and research circles where they challenge yet sharpen each other; guard against arguments, being hurt by friends' words and mutual misunderstanding.
cnDesc: 交友宫坐巨门，朋友多口才好、善分析、敢直言，适合讨论、辩论、研究型圈子，能互相拆台也互相长进；要防口舌争执、被朋友的话刺伤或彼此误解。

cnTitle: 七杀在交友宫：朋友果敢独立，宜一起开拓却防关系来去匆匆
enTitle: Qi-Sha in the Companions Palace: Bold, Independent Friends; Good for Breaking New Ground, Yet Guard Against Ties That Come and Go
enDesc: With Qi-Sha in Companions, friends are bold, driven and independent, suiting breaking new ground and entering new fields, but ties come and go fast, and in cooperation both sides can refuse to yield and clash head-on.
cnDesc: 交友宫坐七杀，朋友多果敢、有冲劲、独立性强，适合一起开拓新局、闯新领域，但关系来得快去得也快，合作中容易各不相让、硬碰硬。

cnTitle: 破军在交友宫：朋友多变敢破局，宜创意圈却防关系突然生变
enTitle: Po-Jun in the Companions Palace: Unconventional, Change-Making Friends; Good for Creative Circles, Yet Guard Against Sudden Shifts in Ties
enDesc: With Po-Jun in Companions, friends are changeable, unconventional and keen to break the old, suiting creative, reforming, experimental circles, but ties are unstable and friends often bring sudden shifts that disrupt your plans.
cnDesc: 交友宫坐破军，朋友多变化大、不按常理、敢破旧立新，适合创意、变革、折腾型圈子，但关系不稳定，朋友常给你带来突发变动，计划容易被打乱。

cnTitle: 火星与铃星：一个快爆、一个闷烧，脾气与火气的两种打开方式
enTitle: Huo-Xing and Ling-Xing: One Quick Burst, One Slow Burn; Two Ways Temper and Flare Play Out
enDesc: Huo-Xing and Ling-Xing are both fiery malefics: Huo-Xing is external, flaring hard and fading fast, while Ling-Xing is internal, simmering until it erupts. Their meaning shifts by palace; the key is quick-burst conflict versus slow-burn resentment.
cnDesc: 火星与铃星同属火性煞星，火星外显、来得猛去得快，铃星内滞、憋久了才爆。两星落不同宫位，象意不同，关键看是快爆型冲突还是闷烧型积怨。

cnTitle: 天刑与天姚：一个管规则法律，一个管魅力名声，边界与分寸
enTitle: Tian-Xing and Tian-Yao: One Rules and Law, One Charm and Reputation; Boundaries and Measure
enDesc: Tian-Xing governs rules, discipline and legal boundaries, while Tian-Yao governs charm, romance and reputation. In contract disputes, PR compliance and brand licensing, they signal separating rules from favor, yet they alone cannot decide a lawsuit.
cnDesc: 天刑主规则、纪律与法律边界，天姚主魅力、桃花与口碑名声。两星落在合约争议、公关合规、品牌授权等场景时，提示要把规矩和情面分开讲清，但它们不能单独断官司。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数迁移宫看异地发展：舞台好看，也要看命官禄财田
enTitle: Reading Relocation Through the Migration Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: A Good Stage, but Read the Whole Chart
enDesc: The Migration Palace is the external field after leaving familiar ground; a fine Migration Palace means smoother stage and benefactors away from home. But strong Migration does not mean you must leave. Read Life, Career, Wealth, Karma and Property together with timing; law, finance, family and health are the necessary conditions, while Wenchang and Wenqu are only clues about language and paperwork.
cnDesc: 迁移宫是离开熟悉环境后的外部场域，它好看说明在外的舞台与贵人缘顺；但强迁移不等于必须离乡，要连看命宫、官禄、财帛、福德、田宅与时间结构，法律、财务、家庭、健康才是能否落地的必要条件，文昌文曲只是语言与文件线索。

cnTitle: 身宫落迁移宫：成长来自变化，也要防过度流动
enTitle: Body Palace in the Migration Palace: Growth Through Change, Guarding Against Excess Motion
enDesc: When the Body Palace sits in Migration, growth comes from environmental change and networks; friends, platforms, travel and outside experience become resources. Moderate movement keeps you active, but watch that excess motion does not disrupt routine or let expertise fail to settle; plan relocation with deliverables and alternate movement with stillness.
cnDesc: 身宫落迁移者，成长多来自环境变化与人际网络，朋友、平台、差旅和异地经历会成为资源；适度移动让人活跃，但要防过度流动导致作息紊乱、专业无法沉淀，建议带着产出目标做异地计划，动静交替。

cnTitle: 福德宫与身宫重合：对情绪和睡眠更敏感的人
enTitle: Karma Palace Meeting the Body Palace: People More Sensitive to Emotion and Sleep
enDesc: When Karma and the Body Palace meet, people are more sensitive to loss, replaying the past and late-night emotions, tending to unsteady sleep, emotional fatigue and a strong need for companionship; this is imagery of emotion and relating, not a diagnosis. With persistent insomnia, anxiety or low mood, seek proper professional support rather than explaining it all by the chart.
cnDesc: 福德与身宫重合者，对失落、旧事回放、深夜情绪较敏感，容易睡眠不稳、情绪疲惫、陪伴需求强；这是情绪与关系的象意，不作诊断。若持续失眠、焦虑或情绪低落，应寻求正规专业支持，不能只靠读盘解释。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数福德宫：你心里踏不踏实，快乐从哪来
enTitle: The Karma Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Whether You Feel Grounded and Where Joy Comes From
enDesc: The Karma Palace is the inner system for being with yourself, digesting stress, nurturing interests, and shaping sleep and emotional stability; it links Life, Body, Spouse, Career and Property, so inner peace must be read together with self-state, relationships, work pressure and living foundation rather than judged in isolation.
cnDesc: 福德宫是与自己相处、消化压力、培养兴趣、决定睡眠与情绪稳定度的内在系统；它联动命身、夫妻、官禄、田宅，要把心里踏实这件事，放进自我状态、关系、工作压力和居住根基一起看，而不是孤立判好坏。

cnTitle: 2026丙午年感情运：廉贞化忌落在夫妻宫怎么读
enTitle: 2026 Bing-Wu Relationship Fortune: How to Read Lianzhen Ji in the Spouse Palace
enDesc: Read yearly relationships through three layers: the natal Spouse Palace, the decade Spouse Palace, then the Bing-Wu transformations. In 2026, Lianzhen Ji landing in Spouse, Life, Karma or Migration often signals tangles, returning old feelings and relational grinding; Ju-Men in Spouse during a fire-heavy year tends to bicker, but the same Ji under different decade foundations may mean quarrels, not breakups.
cnDesc: 看流年感情要叠三层变量：本命夫妻宫、大限夫妻宫，再到丙午年四化。2026廉贞化忌落夫妻、命、福德、迁移，多表纠结、旧情反复与关系磨合；巨门坐夫妻逢火旺年份易口舌，但同一颗忌在不同大限底盘上，可能只是争吵，不等于分手。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数子女宫看教育：亲子关系与切入点
enTitle: Reading Education Through the Children Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Parent-Child Bonds and Entry Points
enDesc: The Children Palace shows parent-child bonds and educational entry points, but cannot alone decide a child ability; read both the parents and the child charts together, then combine Life, Karma, Wenchang-Wenqu and decades and years. Wenchang Ji does not mean hopeless—it may signal pressure on rote text memory while the child has hands-on and creative strengths.
cnDesc: 子女宫看亲子关系与教育切入点，但不能单独决定孩子能力；要同时看父母与孩子两张盘，再结合命宫、福德、文昌文曲与大限流年。文昌化忌不等于没救，可能只是提示文字记忆压力，孩子反而有实作与创意优势。

cnTitle: 夫妻宫也是合伙宫：和另一半共同创业怎么分工
enTitle: The Spouse Palace Is Also the Partnership Palace: Dividing Work When Couples Co-found
enDesc: Beyond marriage, the Spouse Palace is also the partnership palace; for co-founding, read its main star and transformations to set the division of labor. Lu shows whether profit sharing runs smoothly, Quan who calls the shots, and Ji where conflicts hide. The chart is only tendency—major partnerships must rest on written contracts, equity agreements and professional legal advice.
cnDesc: 夫妻宫除婚姻外，也是合伙宫；共同创业要看夫妻宫主星与四化定分工模式。化禄看利益分配顺不顺、化权看谁说了算、化忌看矛盾点在哪。但盘只是倾向，重大合伙务必以书面合同、股权协议和专业律师意见为准。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数田宅宫看资产与居住根基
enTitle: Reading Assets and Living Foundation Through the Property Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: The Property Palace shows fixed assets, living environment and family roots; linked with Karma it shows whether you feel at home, and with Wealth the liquidity of assets. It is a tendency reference and not investment advice; home buying, wealth products and asset allocation rest on licensed institutions and official product documentation.
cnDesc: 田宅宫看固定资产、居住环境与家庭根基；联动福德看住得安不安心，联动财帛看资产变现能力。它是倾向参考，不构成投资建议，具体购房、理财与资产配置以持牌机构和正规产品说明为准。
